names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 31 Μαΐου, «Άγιος Ιερόθεος ο Νέος ο Ιερομάρτυρας», with the rank words and the epithet ο Νέος left off.

birth.note: saint.gr: «γεννήθηκε περί το 1891 μ.Χ.» — the page's own «περί», about, is why the basis is traditional and not attested, and the heading repeats the year, «(1891 - 1928)».

death.note: saint.gr: «Επειδή ήταν ασθενής, τον οδήγησαν στο νοσοκομείο. Εκεί ο Άγιος Ιερόθεος κοιμήθηκε οσίως το 1928 μ.Χ.»

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026). saint.gr makes him a Russian bishop who died in 1928, so the Russian calendar may well keep him; this row says what was read.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 31ης Μαΐου — «Άγιος Ιερόθεος ο Νέος ο Ιερομάρτυρας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 31 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. **He is not the corpus's Hierotheus the New of Iviron**, although the calendar calls both ο Νέος: that folder is a venerable of Kalamata born in 1686 whose Greek and Romanian rows are both on 13 September, and this is a Russian bishop of Nikolsk born about 1891, so the display name takes the see rather than the epithet. `hieromartyr` is the page's own word for him in both the listing and the heading, although what it narrates is arrest, illness and a death in hospital rather than an execution; that tension is the page's and is quoted in the life. No hymn is printed for him.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
